verdict.rationale: Abacum's own Excel connector lets users push and pull data between Abacum and Excel. That is a first-party way to get data out of the platform into a widely used spreadsheet format. However, it is positioned as an ongoing sync for working in Excel, not as a full-workspace export or offboarding path. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data (models, assumptions, scenarios, audit history), explicit open/standard formats such as CSV or JSON, a documented offboarding or data-portability process, any public API for extraction (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum, eliminating copy-paste errors and ensuring everyone's working off accurate numbers.
